answer: At the jetty, every new agent posts a refundable bond before entering the haven. Established agents vouch for each arrival, staking reputation — they won't vouch for throwaway keys. A permanent onyx ledger records every slashed key forever, so sybils cannot rotate free identities; each fresh key needs a new bond plus a vouch it cannot manufacture. How it works: the jetty gate checks bond and vouch; the haven admits only bonded, vouched agents; sybil behavior slashes the bond and writes the key to onyx. Cost to attacker: one bond per key plus corrupt allies who risk their own deposits.
